subject: Launch pact & implementation roadmap — Orchid AI
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Burke <alex.burke@orchid-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch pact & implementation roadmap — Orchid AI

Alex — thanks again for the demo last week. Attaching a first-pass launch pact (MAP) and a starter implementation timeline so we can align on owners and go-live cadence. High level asks below; details are in the attachment (OrchidAI_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx).

Quick summary / asks:
- Proposed go-live: 2026-12-10 (pilot for 10k daily queries). Please confirm any black-out dates on your side.
- Key milestones I pulled into the MAP: Technical intake (1 week), Integration sprint (3 weeks), Security review & SOC evidence (2 weeks, concurrent), Pilot validation (2 weeks), Production cutover.
- Requested owners: Redwood: Marissa (CS lead) for ops & onboarding; Neha (Post-sales TAM) for technical intake; Kar... (me) will coordinate procurement/SOW/contracting.
- Risk: If SOC evidence takes longer than 2 weeks, pilot may slip — flagging early.

Next steps: Can you confirm owners on your side for the integration lead and security contact? Also please review the milestone dates in the attached MAP and SOW draft and suggest edits by EOD Thursday (10/08).

Attachments: OrchidAI_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP), SOW_OrchidAI_draft.pdf (SOW)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime

From: Alex Burke <alex.burke@orchid-ai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sandra Liu <sandra@orchid-ai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch pact & implementation roadmap — Orchid AI

Karthik — appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear MAP. A few notes from our side: thanks for flagging SOC timelines. Our security lead (Sandra) is copied; she noted we will need 1 extra week for the internal legal review of evidence and may request a short call with your compliance team to walk the artifacts.

Proposed edits to milestones (high level):
- Technical intake kickoff: 2026-10-18 (our integration lead will not be available until then)
- Integration sprint: 2026-10-19 — 2026-11-09 (3 weeks)
- Security evidence & legal review: 2026-11-02 — 2026-11-16 (concurrent, adding 1 week buffer)
- Pilot window: 2026-11-20 — 2026-12-03
- Production cutover: target 2026-12-15 (two business weeks after pilot)

Notes/asks:
- We need the SOW to include a short addendum on data retention defaults and logs retention (our procurement will push on this).
- Can Redwood provide a 1-hour technical intake slot the week of 10/18 — ideally Oct 19 or Oct 20.

I'll loop Sandra for the compliance sync. If these dates look broadly OK to Redwood, we can lock the MAP and then route the SOW through procurement.

Best,
Alex Burke
CTO, Orchid AI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Burke <alex.burke@orchid-ai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch pact & implementation roadmap — Orchid AI

Alex / team — thanks for the quick feedback and for looping Sandra. Welcome, very excited to partner on the rollout. I pulled the dates into an operational view and added owners below (inline since some folks are out next week):

Operational MAP (updated) — owners & local tasks:
- Technical intake kickoff (owner: Neha Kapoor, Redwood TAM) — proposed 2026-10-19. Deliverables: environment checklist, API credentials, test tokens.
- Integration sprint (owner: Integration Team at Orchid; Redwood SME: Marissa Cole) — 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-09. Deliverables: webhook integration, batching config, latency baseline.
- Compliance & evidence review (Redwood: Security Ops; Orchid: Sandra Liu) — 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-16. Action: 1-hour artifacts review call (suggest 11/04).
- Pilot validation (Redwood CS lead: Marissa) — 2026-11-20 to 2026-12-03. Deliverables: performance report, anomaly checklist, rollback plan.
- Production cutover (owner: Alex Burke / Orchid) — target 2026-12-15. Pre-cutover checklist due 2026-12-10.

Operational asks from Redwood:
1) Confirm integration lead at Orchid (name + email) so Neha can send the intake packet.
2) Confirm availability for artifacts review call on 2026-11-04 or 11/05.

Procurement/SOW notes: Kar will shepherd SOW redlines; I can provide a short appendix that maps MAP milestones to acceptance criteria for each stage (helps procurement accept go/no-go gates).

Attachments referenced: OrchidAI_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (updated with owners), SOW_OrchidAI_draft.pdf

Happy to take the first intake call — Neha will coordinate calendar invites after you share your integration lead.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch pact & implementation roadmap — Orchid AI

Alex — thanks, this looks good and appreciated the buffer for security review. Final notes from my side:
- I've assigned Neha as lead for the technical intake; she will send the intake packet and calendar invitations once you confirm the Orchid integration contact (please send name/email).
- I'll work with procurement to incorporate the short retention appendix Marissa mentioned and route the SOW for signature. Expect a redline by Monday (10/12).
- Marissa — please prepare the acceptance criteria appendix and share as a one-pager; I'll attach to the SOW when we circulate to procurement.

If Orchid confirms the integration lead by EOD Friday (10/09) we will lock the kickoff for 10/19. Otherwise we'll need to shift the intake one week later.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
